weights.analysis: W_out and W_in moved 3.20 and 3.18 on introducing all six routes.

effective_updates.analysis: W_in takes the biggest effective step at .0729 although QKV raw gradient leads at .446.

tokens_and_objectives.analysis: Word-form loss .00205 exceeds the other two forms again; task/role cosine .055 remains small.

representations.analysis: Force holdout binding rose to .216 and within-paraphrase geometry fell to .325. The h0 margin is .0032.

causal.analysis: Forward value patch falls to 56/90, even though ordinary forward answers remain perfect. Force mass swap matches acceleration more often than mass.

capabilities.analysis: Forward and third-source panels retain perfect scores; reverse slips to 7/9.

failures.analysis: Withheld 4 keeps yielding 6. Broader numeric conversion accuracy is 3.12%.

alternatives.analysis: Training all directions may distribute the number signal across more sites. The fall in a single patch site does not by itself distinguish distribution from interference.

decision.analysis: Keep the six-direction curriculum and observe adaptation before changing targets again.
